title: Maa's Daily Cycle 1 Hour + Morning Fog
description: The data pack increases the daily cycle to 1 hour and adds morning fog.
body:
This small data pack changes the daily cycle from 20 minutes to 1 hour and adds fog at dawn. This data package may not be compatible with data packages that change time scales, but it should be compatible with all others.
